parts.text: I plan and run flights for my company, and I am the licensed person responsible for each flight. Several dispatchers plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and popular drones, and I decide which drone flies along which way and sign off the flight before it leaves. I need help finding out which of my drones could get to where a job starts, but our policy is that software never chooses a drone or a way for us. I don't know what differs between industries like parcel delivery, inspection, and hospital logistics, because each company's fleet, jobs, sites, and problems are its own business.
